notes_for_editor: Identity is unresolved. The Baldy N.T. page has coordinates and elevation only; the elevation is printed as 2310 with no unit, so the story gives it without one. The name suffix N.T. is not explained anywhere readable. Its coordinates (49.167, -119.25) fall in Okanagan-Similkameen, where the 1925 and 1926 Mount Baldy reports place a lookout near Penticton; the story says the match is not certain. Possible name conflict: N.T. could mean North Thompson, but the North Thompson Baldy near Clearwater is a different record (ca-bc-baldy, firelookout.ca coordinates 51.45174, -120.05205). Canada Lookouts places Baldy (Shundra Mtn) in its Alberta list (Clearwater County is an Alberta county), so it is not a BC alias for this record. The two Mount Baldy pages disagree on region: mount-baldy.html is headed Okanogan - Similkameen (spelled that way on the page) and mount-baldy1.html is headed Thompson - Nicola, although its quotes concern the Inkaneep and Kettle River Forests. The 1925 primary unit and the 1926 new permanent lookout may be one site or two. A BC Forest Fire Lookouts Facebook group post (https://www.facebook.com/groups/bcforestfirelookouts/posts/6509003819214830/) argues the Okanagan Baldy lookout dates from 1926 and that a North Thompson Baldy near Dunn Peak dates from 1927; its text is not readable through fetch_text, so it is not used. A human should decide whether the record's name or location needs correcting; no correction is proposed here. No events are recorded because none can be tied to this record with confidence.
